verification_pipeline_evidence.observed_behavior: An LLM (named 'Gemini' in the UI) drafts claims from agent websites/press. Every claim is then cross-checked against primary sources (SEC Form D XML recipients, FINRA BrokerCheck / FCA Register / Companies House for UK firms). Claims that could not be verified are logged explicitly rather than silently kept or dropped, e.g.: "Snowhawk 'FirstPoint exclusive global PA' - press release names no agent; Form D lists 3 recipients (FirstPoint, Finex HK, BA Securities)"; "GEF US Climate Solutions II '$325M 2024' - Form D/A shows $318M sold"; "FCA FRN 795493 - not found; site states FRN 537110"; "Nexa Equity Fund I - site lists 2022 (press June 2023) - date discrepancy to note".
